item.title: CVE-2026-110447 — Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.
